title: Microsoft Copilot Chat Implementation
description_text:
Pursuant to Section 3-09 of the Procurement Policy Board Rules for Intergovernmental Purchase Method, the New York City Comptrollers Office has awarded a contract to New York State Technology Enterprise Corporation, whose primary address is 99 Otis Street, 2nd Floor, Rome, NY 13441, for the provision of Microsoft Copilot Chat Implementation and Training, with AI Policy Modernization and Governance Alignment Recommendations. The contract amount is 145,000.00, and the contract term is from 05/20/2026 to 04/19/2027.

Any vendor interested in expressing future interest in such type of procurement is invited to do so by submitting an expression of interest to the Procurement Team at opportunity@comptroller.nyc.gov.
